```{r}
save_folder=file.path(base_folder,"4.plotting","output","1.mil")

tmp_df <- df_patient %>%
  # drop_na(GradeOfDysplasia,progression)%>%
  mutate(dysplasia = case_when(
    dysplasia %in% c("LGD","LGD/HGD", "HGD/LGD", "HGD") ~ "Dysplasia",
    dysplasia == "N" ~ "No Dysplasia"))%>%
  mutate(microscopy = factor(dysplasia, levels = c("No Dysplasia", "Dysplasia")),
         flow = factor(flow, levels = c("Diploid","Aneuploid")),
         pred = factor(pred, levels = c("Diploid","Aneuploid")),
         progression = factor(progression, levels = c("CO","NCO")),
    flow_or_pred = factor(
      ifelse(flow == "Aneuploid" | pred == "Aneuploid", 
             "Aneuploid", 
             "Diploid"),
      levels = c("Diploid", "Aneuploid")
    ),
    flow_and_pred = factor(
      ifelse(flow == "Aneuploid" & pred == "Aneuploid", 
             "Aneuploid", 
             "Diploid"),
      levels = c("Diploid", "Aneuploid")
    ))
  
plot_contingency <- function(tmp_df, dataset,var){
  
  var_sym <- sym(var)
  if(dataset != "whole"){
    tmp_df <- tmp_df%>%
      filter(dataset == dataset)
  }
  if(nrow(tmp_df)>0){
  # Calculate p-value
  pval <- table(tmp_df[c(var, 'progression')]) %>%
    chisq.test() %>%
    .$p.value
  
  # Get number of unique levels for annotation positioning
  n_levels <- length(unique(tmp_df[[var]]))
  x_pos <- (n_levels + 1) / 2  # Center the annotation
  
  # Create the plot
  p <- tmp_df %>%
    group_by(!!var_sym, progression) %>%
    summarise(count = n(), .groups = 'drop') %>%
    mutate(prop = count / sum(count)) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = !!var_sym, y = prop, fill = progression)) +
      geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "fill") + 
      geom_text(aes(label = count),
                position = position_fill(vjust = 0.5), 
                size = 3.5) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = c("#762a83", "#1b7837")) +
      labs(x = tools::toTitleCase(var), y = "Proportion (%)") +  # Dynamic x-label
      annotate("text", x = x_pos, y = 1.05, 
               label = bquote(chi^2 ~ ", p=" ~ .(signif(pval, 3))), size = 1.6) +
      theme_light() + 
      theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
            panel.border = element_blank(),
            axis.line = element_line(size = 0.5),
            axis.title = element_text(size = 5),      # Increase axis title size
            axis.text = element_text(size = 4),       # Increase axis text size
            legend.title = element_text(size = 5),    # Control legend title size
            legend.text = element_text(size = 4))
  
  # Save the plot
  ggsave(file.path(save_folder, paste0("co_",dataset,"_", var, ".pdf")), p, height = 3.7, width = 6, units = "cm")
  print(p)
  # Return the plot object
  }
}

for(dset in c("whole","MDA","NU")){
  plot_contingency(tmp_df,dset,"flow")
  plot_contingency(tmp_df,dset,"pred")
  plot_contingency(tmp_df,dset,"flow_or_pred")
  plot_contingency(tmp_df,dset,"flow_and_pred")
  plot_contingency(tmp_df%>%drop_na(dysplasia),dset,"dysplasia")
}
```

```{r demographics table}
summarize_continuous <- function(data, var_name) {
  data %>%
    group_by(dataset) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_val = round(mean(!!sym(var_name), na.rm = TRUE), 1),
      sd_val = round(sd(!!sym(var_name), na.rm = TRUE), 1),
      median_val = round(median(!!sym(var_name), na.rm = TRUE), 1),
      iqr_25 = round(quantile(!!sym(var_name), 0.25, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
      iqr_75 = round(quantile(!!sym(var_name), 0.75, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
      n_missing = sum(is.na(!!sym(var_name))),
      .groups = 'drop'
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      summary = paste0(mean_val, " (", sd_val, ")"),
      # Alternative: median and IQR format
      # summary = paste0(median_val, " (", iqr_25, "-", iqr_75, ")")
    )
}

# Function to calculate summary statistics for categorical variables
summarize_categorical <- function(data, var_name) {
  data %>%
    filter(!is.na(!!sym(var_name))) %>%
    count(dataset, !!sym(var_name)) %>%
    group_by(dataset) %>%
    mutate(
      total = sum(n),
      percentage = round((n / total) * 100, 1),
      summary = paste0(n, " (", percentage, "%)")
    ) %>%
    ungroup()
}

perform_test <- function(data, var_name, var_type = "continuous") {
  if (var_type == "continuous") {
    # t-test or Mann-Whitney U test
    discovery_vals <- data[data$dataset == "Discovery", var_name]
    test_vals <- data[data$dataset == "Test", var_name]
    
    # Remove NA values
    discovery_vals <- discovery_vals[!is.na(discovery_vals)]
    test_vals <- test_vals[!is.na(test_vals)]
    
    # Perform t-test (you might want to use wilcox.test instead)
    if (length(discovery_vals) > 0 & length(test_vals) > 0) {
      test_result <- t.test(discovery_vals, test_vals)
      return(sprintf("%.2e", test_result$p.value))
    } else {
      return(NA)
    }
  } else {
    # Chi-square test for categorical variables
    cont_table <- table(data$dataset, data[[var_name]])
    if (all(dim(cont_table) > 1) & all(cont_table >= 5)) {
      test_result <- chisq.test(cont_table)
      return(sprintf("%.2e", test_result$p.value))
    } else {
      # Use Fisher's exact test for small counts
      test_result <- fisher.test(cont_table)
      return(sprintf("%.2e", test_result$p.value))
    }
  }
}
```

```{r}
create_demographics_table <- function(dataset) {
    results <- data.frame(
    Variable = character(),
    Discovery = character(),
    Test = character(),
    p_value = numeric(),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  # Age
  age_summary <- summarize_continuous(dataset, "age")
  age_p <- perform_test(dataset, "age", "continuous")
  
  age_df <- age_summary%>%
    select(dataset,summary)%>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = dataset, values_from = summary)%>%
    mutate(Variable = "Age, mean (SD)",
           p_value = age_p)%>%
    relocate(Variable, .before =everything())

  results <- rbind(results, age_df)
  
  # sex
  sex_summary <- summarize_categorical(dataset, "sex")
  sex_p <- perform_test(dataset, "sex", "categorical")
  
  results <- rbind(results, data.frame(
    Variable = "Sex, n (%)",
    Discovery = "",
    Test = "",
    p_value = sex_p
  ))
  
  unique_sex <- unique(dataset$sex)
  for (sex_level in unique_sex[!is.na(unique_sex)]) {
    sex_subset <- sex_summary[sex_summary$sex == sex_level, ]
    results <- rbind(results, data.frame(
      Variable = paste0("  ", sex_level),
      Discovery = ifelse(nrow(sex_subset[sex_subset$dataset == "Discovery", ]) > 0,
                        sex_subset$summary[sex_subset$dataset == "Discovery"], "0 (0%)"),
      Test = ifelse(nrow(sex_subset[sex_subset$dataset == "Test", ]) > 0,
                   sex_subset$summary[sex_subset$dataset == "Test"], "0 (0%)"),
      p_value = NA
    ))
  }
    
  # Progression
  prog_summary <- summarize_categorical(dataset, "progression")
  prog_p <- perform_test(dataset, "progression", "categorical")
  
  # Add main category header
  results <- rbind(results, data.frame(
    Variable = "Progression, n (%)",
    Discovery = "",
    Test = "",
    p_value = prog_p
  ))
  
  

  
  # Add subcategories
  unique_prog <- unique(dataset$progression)
  for (prog_level in unique_prog[!is.na(unique_prog)]) {
    prog_subset <- prog_summary[prog_summary$progression == prog_level, ]
    results <- rbind(results, data.frame(
      Variable = paste0("  ", prog_level),
      Discovery = ifelse(nrow(prog_subset[prog_subset$dataset == "Discovery", ]) > 0,
                        prog_subset$summary[prog_subset$dataset == "Discovery"], "0 (0%)"),
      Test = ifelse(nrow(prog_subset[prog_subset$dataset == "Test", ]) > 0,
                   prog_subset$summary[prog_subset$dataset == "Test"], "0 (0%)"),
      p_value = NA
    ))
  }
  
  # Flow
  flow_summary <- summarize_categorical(dataset, "flow")
  flow_p <- perform_test(dataset, "flow", "categorical")
  
  results <- rbind(results, data.frame(
    Variable = "Flow, n (%)",
    Discovery = "",
    Test = "",
    p_value = flow_p
  ))
  
  unique_flow <- unique(dataset$flow)
  for (flow_level in unique_flow[!is.na(unique_flow)]) {
    flow_subset <- flow_summary[flow_summary$flow == flow_level, ]
    results <- rbind(results, data.frame(
      Variable = paste0("  ", flow_level),
      Discovery = ifelse(nrow(flow_subset[flow_subset$dataset == "Discovery", ]) > 0,
                        flow_subset$summary[flow_subset$dataset == "Discovery"], "0 (0%)"),
      Test = ifelse(nrow(flow_subset[flow_subset$dataset == "Test", ]) > 0,
                   flow_subset$summary[flow_subset$dataset == "Test"], "0 (0%)"),
      p_value = NA
    ))
  }
  
  # Grade of Dysplasia
  dysp_summary <- summarize_categorical(dataset, "dysplasia")
  dysp_p <- perform_test(dataset, "dysplasia", "categorical")
  
  results <- rbind(results, data.frame(
    Variable = "Grade of Dysplasia, n (%)",
    Discovery = "",
    Test = "",
    p_value = dysp_p
  ))
  
  unique_dysp <- unique(dataset$dysplasia)
  for (dysp_level in unique_dysp[!is.na(unique_dysp)]) {
    dysp_subset <- dysp_summary[dysp_summary$dysplasia == dysp_level, ]
    results <- rbind(results, data.frame(
      Variable = paste0("  ", dysp_level),
      Discovery = ifelse(nrow(dysp_subset[dysp_subset$dataset == "Discovery", ]) > 0,
                        dysp_subset$summary[dysp_subset$dataset == "Discovery"], "0 (0%)"),
      Test = ifelse(nrow(dysp_subset[dysp_subset$dataset == "Test", ]) > 0,
                   dysp_subset$summary[dysp_subset$dataset == "Test"], "0 (0%)"),
      p_value = NA
    ))
  }
  
  
  # Follow-up time
  followup_summary <- summarize_continuous(dataset%>%
                                             mutate(fu_time = fu_time *12 / 365.25), "fu_time")
  followup_p <- perform_test(dataset, "fu_time", "continuous")
  
  results <- rbind(results, data.frame(
    Variable = "Follow-up month, mean (SD)",
    Discovery = followup_summary$summary[followup_summary$dataset == "Discovery"],
    Test = followup_summary$summary[followup_summary$dataset == "Test"],
    p_value = followup_p
  ))
  
  # BE Length
  BELength_summary <- summarize_continuous(dataset, "BELength")
  BELength_p <- perform_test(dataset, "BELength", "continuous")
  
  BELength_df <- BELength_summary%>%
    select(dataset,summary)%>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = dataset, values_from = summary)%>%
    mutate(Variable = "BE Length, mean (SD)",
           p_value = BELength_p)%>%
    relocate(Variable, .before =everything())

  results <- rbind(results, BELength_df)
    
  if ("biopsy_per_patient" %in% colnames(dataset)){
  bpp_summary <- summarize_continuous(dataset, "biopsy_per_patient")
  bpp_p <- perform_test(dataset, "biopsy_per_patient", "continuous")
  
    results <- rbind(results, data.frame(
    Variable = "Biopsy-per-patient (SD)",
    Discovery = bpp_summary$summary[bpp_summary$dataset == "Discovery"],
    Test = bpp_summary$summary[bpp_summary$dataset == "Test"],
    p_value = bpp_p
    ))
  }

  
  return(results)
}
```

# dem cox
```{r dem cox}

perform_cox_analysis <- function(data, dataset_name) {
  
  # Check if required columns exist
  required_cols <- c("Age", "Sex",  "flow", "fu_time", "event")
  missing_cols <- setdiff(required_cols, names(data))
  if(length(missing_cols) > 0) {
    warning(paste("Missing columns for dataset", dataset_name, ":", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", ")))
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Remove rows with missing data
  data_clean <- data[complete.cases(data[, required_cols]), ]
  
  if(nrow(data_clean) < 10) {
    warning(paste("Dataset", dataset_name, "has insufficient data after cleaning"))
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Create survival object
  surv_obj <- Surv(data_clean$fu_time, data_clean$event)
  
  # Variables to analyze
  variables <- c("Age", "Sex",  "flow")
  
  # Initialize results dataframe
  results <- data.frame(
    Dataset = character(),
    Variable = character(),
    Analysis = character(),
    HR = numeric(),
    CI_lower = numeric(),
    CI_upper = numeric(),
    P_value = numeric(),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  significant_vars <- character()

  # Univariate analysis
  cat("Performing univariate analysis for dataset:", dataset_name, "\n")
  
  for(var in variables) {
    tryCatch({
      # Create formula
      formula_str <- paste("surv_obj ~", var)
      cox_model <- coxph(as.formula(formula_str), data = data_clean)
      
      # Extract results
      summary_cox <- summary(cox_model)
      
      # Check if this variable is significant (any coefficient p-value < threshold)
      var_is_significant <- FALSE
      
      # Get coefficients
      if(nrow(summary_cox$coefficients) > 0) {
        for(i in 1:nrow(summary_cox$coefficients)) {
          coef_name <- rownames(summary_cox$coefficients)[i]
          p_value <- summary_cox$coefficients[i, "Pr(>|z|)"]
          
          # Check if this coefficient is significant
          if(p_value < 0.05) {
            var_is_significant <- TRUE
          }
          
          results <- rbind(results, data.frame(
            Dataset = dataset_name,
            Variable = paste0(var, "_", gsub(paste0("^", var), "", coef_name)),
            Analysis = "Univariate",
            HR = summary_cox$coefficients[i, "exp(coef)"],
            CI_lower = summary_cox$conf.int[i, "lower .95"],
            CI_upper = summary_cox$conf.int[i, "upper .95"],
            P_value = p_value,
            stringsAsFactors = FALSE
          ))
        }
        
        # Add to significant variables if any coefficient was significant
        if(var_is_significant) {
          significant_vars <- c(significant_vars, var)
        }
      }
    }, error = function(e) {
      cat("Error in univariate analysis for", var, "in dataset", dataset_name, ":", e$message, "\n")
    })
  }
  
  # Report significant variables
  if(length(significant_vars) > 0) {
    cat("Significant variables (p <", 0.05, ") for dataset", dataset_name, ":", paste(significant_vars, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  } else {
    cat("No significant variables found for dataset", dataset_name, "- skipping multivariate analysis\n\n")
    return(results)
  }
  
  # Multivariate analysis (only if we have significant variables)
  if(length(significant_vars) > 1) {
    cat("Performing multivariate analysis for dataset:", dataset_name, "\n")
    
    tryCatch({
      # Create multivariate formula with only significant variables
      formula_mv <- paste("surv_obj ~", paste(significant_vars, collapse = " + "))
      cox_mv <- coxph(as.formula(formula_mv), data = data_clean)
      
      # Extract results
      summary_mv <- summary(cox_mv)
      
      # Get coefficients
      if(nrow(summary_mv$coefficients) > 0) {
        for(i in 1:nrow(summary_mv$coefficients)) {
          coef_name <- rownames(summary_mv$coefficients)[i]
          
          # Find which variable this coefficient belongs to
          var_match <- significant_vars[sapply(significant_vars, function(v) grepl(paste0("^", v), coef_name))]
          if(length(var_match) > 0) {
            var_name <- var_match[1]
            coef_suffix <- gsub(paste0("^", var_name), "", coef_name)
            display_name <- paste0(var_name, "_", coef_suffix)
          } else {
            display_name <- coef_name
          }
          
          results <- rbind(results, data.frame(
            Dataset = dataset_name,
            Variable = display_name,
            Analysis = "Multivariate",
            HR = summary_mv$coefficients[i, "exp(coef)"],
            CI_lower = summary_mv$conf.int[i, "lower .95"],
            CI_upper = summary_mv$conf.int[i, "upper .95"],
            P_value = summary_mv$coefficients[i, "Pr(>|z|)"],
            stringsAsFactors = FALSE
          ))
        }
      }
      
      # Add model statistics
      cat("Model statistics for", dataset_name, ":\n")
      cat("- Concordance:", summary_mv$concordance[1], "\n")
      cat("- Likelihood ratio test p-value:", summary_mv$logtest[3], "\n")
      cat("- Wald test p-value:", summary_mv$waldtest[3], "\n")
      cat("- Score test p-value:", summary_mv$sctest[3], "\n\n")
      
    }, error = function(e) {
      cat("Error in multivariate analysis for dataset", dataset_name, ":", e$message, "\n")
    })
  } else if(length(significant_vars) == 1) {
    cat("Only one significant variable found for dataset", dataset_name, "- multivariate analysis not needed\n\n")
  }
  
  return(results)
}

run_cox_analysis_by_dataset <- function(df) {
  
  # Check if dataset column exists
  if(!"dataset" %in% names(df)) {
    stop("Dataset column 'dataset' not found in dataframe")
  }
  
  # Get unique datasets
  datasets <- unique(df$dataset)
  cat("Found", length(datasets), "datasets:", paste(datasets, collapse = ", "), "\n\n")
  
  # Initialize combined results
  all_results <- data.frame()
  
  # Process each dataset
  for(ds in datasets) {
    cat("=== Processing Dataset:", ds, "===\n")
    
    # Subset data for current dataset
    dataset_data <- df[df$dataset == ds, ]
    cat("Dataset", ds, "has", nrow(dataset_data), "observations\n")
    
    # Perform analysis
    results <- perform_cox_analysis(dataset_data, ds)
    
    if(!is.null(results)) {
      all_results <- rbind(all_results, results)
    }
    
    cat("\n")
  }
  
  # Format results for better presentation
  all_results$HR_CI <- paste0(
    round(all_results$HR, 2), " (", 
    round(all_results$CI_lower, 2), "-", 
    round(all_results$CI_upper, 2), ")"
  )
  
  all_results$P_value_formatted <- ifelse(
    all_results$P_value < 0.001, 
    "<0.001", 
    round(all_results$P_value, 3)
  )
  
  # Create summary table
  summary_table <- all_results[, c("Dataset", "Variable", "Analysis", "HR_CI", "P_value_formatted")]
  names(summary_table) <- c("Dataset", "Variable", "Analysis", "HR (95% CI)", "P-value")
  
  return(list(
    detailed_results = all_results,
    summary_table = summary_table
  ))
}
```

```{r}
create_publication_table <- function(results) {
  
  # Reshape data for better presentation
  pub_table <- results$detailed_results %>%
    select(Dataset, Variable, Analysis, HR, CI_lower, CI_upper, P_value) %>%
    mutate(
      HR_formatted = paste0(sprintf("%.2f", HR), " (", 
                           sprintf("%.2f", CI_lower), "-", 
                           sprintf("%.2f", CI_upper), ")"),
      P_formatted = case_when(
        P_value < 0.001 ~ "<0.001",
        P_value < 0.01 ~ sprintf("%.3f", P_value),
        TRUE ~ sprintf("%.3f", P_value)
      )
    ) %>%
    select(Dataset, Variable, Analysis, HR_formatted, P_formatted) %>%
    rename("HR (95% CI)" = HR_formatted, "P-value" = P_formatted)
  
  return(pub_table)
}
create_publication_table(results)
```

```{r}
plot_forest <- function(plot_df, metric="flow",variables, title = NA){
  main <- ifelse(!is.na(title), paste("Hazard ratio", title, sep = "-"), "Hazard ratio")
  plot_df <- plot_df%>%
    filter(fu_time>14 & !is.na(fu_time))
  variables <- c("age","sex","dysplasia", "BELength",metric)
  surv_obj <- Surv(plot_df$fu_time, plot_df$event)
  formula_mv <- paste("surv_obj ~", paste(variables, collapse = " + "))
  control = coxph.control(iter.max=100)
  cox_mv <- coxph(as.formula(formula_mv), data = as.data.frame(plot_df), control = control)
  p <- ggforest(cox_mv, data = as.data.frame(plot_df), fontsize = 1.1, main = main)
  print(p)
  return(p)

}
```

```{r}
library(survival)
library(broom)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

plot_uni <- function(df_patient_tmp_eco){
# Define variables
variables <- c("age", "sex", "dysplasia", "BELength","risk_category_01_2")

# Create survival object
surv_obj <- Surv(plot_df$fu_time, plot_df$event)

# Run univariate Cox models
univariate_results <- lapply(variables, function(var) {
  formula <- as.formula(paste("surv_obj ~", var))
  cox_model <- coxph(formula, data = plot_df)
  
  tidy(cox_model, exponentiate = TRUE, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(variable = var) %>%
    select(variable, term, HR = estimate, 
           CI_lower = conf.low, CI_upper = conf.high, 
           p.value)
})

# Combine results
results_df <- bind_rows(univariate_results)
results_df <- results_df %>%
  filter_all(all_vars(!is.infinite(.)))

# Create labels with HR and CI
results_df <- results_df %>%
  mutate(
    HR_label = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f-%.2f)", HR, CI_lower, CI_upper),
    p_label = ifelse(p.value < 0.001, "P<0.001", 
                     sprintf("P=%.3f", p.value)),
    # Clean term names for display
    term_clean = gsub("dysplasiayes", "Dysplasia: Yes", term),
    term_clean = gsub("SexM", "Sex: Male", term_clean),
    term_clean = gsub("flowAneuploid", "Flow: Aneuploid", term_clean),
    term_clean = gsub("^Age$", "Age", term_clean),
    term_clean = gsub("^BELength$", "BE Length", term_clean),
    row_order = row_number()
  )
  
p <- ggplot(results_df, aes(y = reorder(term_clean, -row_order), x = HR)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40", size = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 4, color = "#2C3E50") +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = CI_lower, xmax = CI_upper), 
                 height = 0.3, size = 0.8, color = "#2C3E50") +
  geom_text(aes(x = max(CI_upper, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.5, label = HR_label),
            hjust = 0, size = 3.5) +
  geom_text(aes(x = max(CI_upper, na.rm = TRUE) * 3, label = p_label),
            hjust = 0, size = 3.5) +
  scale_x_log10(
    breaks = c(0.1, 0.5, 1, 2, 5, 10),
    labels = c("0.1", "0.5", "1", "2", "5", "10")
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(min(results_df$CI_lower, na.rm = TRUE) * 0.5,
                           max(results_df$CI_upper, na.rm = TRUE) * 4)) +
  labs(
    title = "Univariate Cox Regression Analysis",
    subtitle = paste0("N = ", nrow(plot_df), " patients, ", 
                     sum(plot_df$event), " events"),
    x = "Hazard Ratio (95% CI)",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  annotate("text", x = max(results_df$CI_upper, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.5, 
           y = nrow(results_df) + 0.7, label = "HR (95% CI)", 
           fontface = "bold", hjust = 0, size = 3.5) +
  annotate("text", x = max(results_df$CI_upper, na.rm = TRUE) * 3, 
           y = nrow(results_df) + 0.7, label = "P-value", 
           fontface = "bold", hjust = 0, size = 3.5) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "gray90"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 11, color = "black"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold", margin = margin(t = 10)),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10, color = "gray40")
  )

print(p)
return(p)
}
```
